name: Hanaoni ~Yume no Tsuzuki~
source:
This is the fandisk to Hanaoni. There are 4 sections: Bride Excerpts, Honeymoon Arc, Hina Party and a Monologue section from each guy at the end. Additionally in this fandisk, Watase gets a route.

[from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/03/25/otome-game-review-hanaoni-yume-no-tsuzuki/]Hinano's blog[/url]]
translation:
这是《华鬼》的Fan Disc。分为四个部分：新娘篇摘录、蜜月篇、雏祭典，以及最后每位男主角的独白部分。此外，在这部Fan Disc中，渡濑获得了个人路线。

[引自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/03/25/otome-game-review-hanaoni-yume-no-tsuzuki/]Hinano's blog[/url]]
